operation.description: Creates a label for the specified repository with the given name and color. The name and color parameters are required. The color must be a valid [hexadecimal color code](http://www.color-hex.com/).

color.description: The [hexadecimal color code](http://www.color-hex.com/) for the label, without the leading `#`.

description.description: A short description of the label. Must be 100 characters or fewer.

name.description: The name of the label. Emoji can be added to label names, using either native emoji or colon-style markup. For example, typing `:strawberry:` will render the emoji ![:strawberry:](https://github.githubassets.com/images/icons/emoji/unicode/1f353.png ":strawberry:"). For a full list of available emoji and codes, see "[Emoji cheat sheet](https://github.com/ikatyang/emoji-cheat-sheet)."

#/components/parameters/owner.description: The account owner of the repository. The name is not case sensitive.
#/components/parameters/owner.name: owner

#/components/parameters/repo.description: The name of the repository without the `.git` extension. The name is not case sensitive.
#/components/parameters/repo.name: repo

#/components/responses/validation_failed.description: Validation failed, or the endpoint has been spammed.

#/components/schemas/label.description: Color-coded labels help you categorize and filter your issues (just like labels in Gmail).

color.description: 6-character hex code, without the leading #, identifying the color

default.description: Whether this label comes by default in a new repository.

description.description: Optional description of the label, such as its purpose.

#/components/schemas/label.title: Label
